metadata.policy: Fixed named synchronous profiles in run.py; local synthetic callbacks and dispatch recorders only. Raw query ToolGuard and configured decoded-query recipe use SecretScanner then PII email/phone; the shipped recipe default covers secrets/email. Decoded finding offsets are separate from serialized handoff offsets. No network calls or general accuracy claims.
metadata.timing_scope: Setup-inclusive synchronous observations: policy construction, SDK/recipe checks, local callbacks, exact comparisons and privacy checks. Microseconds from perf_counter_ns; short synthetic inputs on this host, not scanner-only timing, capacity evidence or a deadline guarantee.
